approved_copy.one_sentence_explanation: Reviewed House vote evidence exists in both the 118th and 119th Congresses for these policy-question families.
approved_copy.no_eligible_families_state: No reviewed family has enough House vote evidence in both Congresses for this panel yet.
approved_copy.prior_congress_only_state: Reviewed family evidence is available in the 118th Congress, but not in the 119th Congress for this official.
approved_copy.recent_congress_only_state: Reviewed family evidence is available in the 119th Congress, but not in the 118th Congress for this official.
approved_copy.not_voting_caveat: Not-voting rows are shown separately and are not counted as Yes or No votes.
approved_copy.missing_no_record_caveat: Missing/no-record means this official has no counted vote row for that roll call in the reviewed data.
approved_copy.related_unavailable_note: Related rows that do not meet the family standard are not shown in this panel.
approved_copy.why_not_inference_explanation: This panel places reviewed roll-call evidence from two Congresses side by side. It does not describe what that means about the official's views, behavior, or reasons.
approved_copy.source_evidence_drilldown_prompt: Open the roll-call evidence used for this family.
